newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen opening down.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen opening down.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open down Monday on follow-through from the Dow industrials' 148-point decline Friday, analysts said.
"I think we'll have an easier opening," said Larry Wachtel, an analyst at Prudential Securities. "I think the key to the marning will be what happened Friday.

Investors also will keep an eye on semiconductor maker Intel Corp's first quarter earnings, due out after the market closes at 1600 EDT/1800 GMT. The results could provide direction for slumping technology stocks.
